headline: Nifty eyes resistance at 23,200 as Q2 earnings and corporate deals drive sentiment

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Traders are watching Nifty resistance at 23,200 ahead of the Diwali week.
Investors are tracking a fresh batch of Q2 earnings declared on November 2.
Global oil dynamics remain in focus with crude trading above $116 and OPEC+ retaining output targets.
Key corporate announcements including acquisitions and MCLR rate updates are driving market activity.
whatHappening: Punjab National Bank hiked its MCLR rates across select tenures.
Affle 3i announced a $420 million all-cash deal to acquire Israel-based Perion Network.
Yes Bank rejected allegations of non-compliance after the Supreme Court verdict on its AT-1 bonds.
CBI extradited Mahadev app accused Sourabh Chandrakar from Oman in a Rs 6,000-crore betting case.
summary: Indian stock markets open for trading today as investors focus on Q2 earnings reports and trade setup levels. Key stock-specific actions include PNB's MCLR hike and Affle 3i's $420M acquisition of Perion Network. Market participants are monitoring whether Nifty can break past resistance at 23,200 during the week.
